T: Shaken, not stirred. Gold, not silver.

P: Serve the drinks when Goldfinger offers Bond a mint julep at his Kentucky stud farm.

s.note: Kentucky gold, cut into bullion bars
s.how: Mix 200g cornmeal, 150g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 50g sugar, 2 eggs, 300ml buttermilk and 80g melted butter. Bake in a lined 20 by 30cm tin at 200C for 22 minutes, cut into bars and serve with 100g butter beaten with 2 tbsp honey.

s.note: the Miami Beach hotel pool where it starts
s.how: Mix 300g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, a finely diced celery stick, chopped chives, lemon zest and juice and a pinch of paprika. Spoon into 12 baby cos leaves and serve cold.

m.how: Roast 1kg potatoes in beef dripping or oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear 4 sirloins hard and rest. Deglaze with 60ml bourbon and crushed pepper, add 125ml stock and 200ml cream and reduce.

w.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 250g chopped dark chocolate. Stir smooth and chill 3 hours. Roll into balls, dust in cocoa, then roll in edible gold lustre until they shine.

d.note: Goldfinger offers Bond one at the farm
d.how: For each drink, gently press 8 mint leaves with 15ml sugar syrup in a metal cup. Add 60ml bourbon, pack with crushed ice and stir until the cup frosts. Top with a big mint sprig. Makes four.
